_comment: Gemini->Responses contract. Post-commit truncation toward Gemini SSE: upstream Responses SSE ends after a partial text delta with no terminal usage. The router holds HTTP 200 and emits one native sanitized error frame, with no Gemini terminal and no [DONE].
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.respup]
dialect = "openai-responses"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}/v1"
api_key = "resp-secret"

[[models]]
name = "gem-resp"
provider = "respup"
model = "gpt-4.1"
name: gemini_to_responses_sse_truncated
